issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, while the intended/implemented design uses an int. The problem text even tells students to check the UML for the expected return type. If a student follows the UML (String) they will implement a different signature than the solution/tests expect (int), causing confusion and failing tests.
issues.suggested_fix: Correct the UML and problem text to state getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (not String), so it matches the intended implementation and tests. Alternatively, if the intention is for getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return a String, update the solution and any tests to return String consistently. Prefer updating the UML to 'int' because total number of students is naturally an integer.
